---
title: "Research"
description: |
  My research focuses on the impact of knowledge flows and local capabilities on innovation, technology adoption, and development. The theoretical framework from which I approach these phenomena considers the social interactions that characterise the economy as a complex system. From this perspective, it is understood that the system evolves partially conditioned by its past and the territory in which economic activities occur.

  My main papers have been published in:
